description: A module the maker has not finished: the panel carries the controls for a planned elliptic curve oscillator, filter and envelope, and none of them is read yet

params.text: Nothing in the module reads this knob; the per-sample function is empty

inputs.text: Nothing in the module reads this jack; the per-sample function is empty

outputs.text: Nothing in the module writes this jack, so it carries 0V on every channel

notes: the maker's README says this module is in development and displays the interface with no processing, and the code agrees: the function that would do the work contains an empty loop
the outputs take the channel count of the widest input patched, and every channel of every output carries 0V
